entries.before: Mana's light is an infinite, all-purpose source of energy,#nand it can also exert a profound influence on the human mind.
entries.en: The Light of Mana is an infinite, all-purpose source of energy,#nand it can also exert a profound influence on the human mind.

entries.before: "The light of Mana was a new power#nbrought to humanity several hundred years ago."
entries.en: "The Light of Mana was a new power#nbrought to humanity several hundred years ago."

entries.before: "The light of Mana, with its limitless, all-powerful strength,#nwas given to every human being."
entries.en: "The Light of Mana, with its limitless, all-powerful strength,#nwas given to every human being."

entries.before: "The light of Mana solved all the problems facing humanity,#nincluding shortages of energy and food."
entries.en: "The Light of Mana solved all the problems facing humanity,#nincluding shortages of energy and food."

entries.before: "With the light of Mana, people achieved their ideals and no longer#nneeded to fight, creating a peaceful world."
entries.en: "With the Light of Mana, people achieved their ideals and no longer#nneeded to fight, creating a peaceful world."

entries.before: "The world reached the height of prosperity through the light of Mana.#nBut something appeared to disturb that peace."
entries.en: "The world reached the height of prosperity through the Light of Mana.#nBut something appeared to disturb that peace."

entries.before: "For reasons unknown, the light of Mana did not work on DRAGONs,#nand they reportedly wreaked destruction wherever they went."
entries.en: "For reasons unknown, the Light of Mana did not work on DRAGONs,#nand they reportedly wreaked destruction wherever they went."

entries.before: "Meanwhile, it was discovered that, on very rare occasions,#nchildren were born without the light of Mana."
entries.en: "Meanwhile, it was discovered that, on very rare occasions,#nchildren were born without the Light of Mana."

entries.before: "From birth, Norma cannot accept the light of Mana,#nnor can they use it."
entries.en: "From birth, Norma cannot accept the Light of Mana,#nnor can they use it."

entries.before: "At Arzenal, we educate Norma who lack the light of Mana#nand train them to be useful to the world. Understood?"
